broad.name: Learning quantum systems
broad.description: Papers that learn states, Hamiltonians, entanglement and phases from data, with provable learning algorithms or with neural networks.

broad.name: Quantum machine learning
broad.description: Papers that build, benchmark and apply quantum machine-learning models (kernels, neural networks, generative models, reservoirs) to classical data.

broad.name: Quantum computing for finance
broad.description: Papers that apply quantum algorithms and quantum machine learning to pricing, risk, portfolio selection and financial prediction.

broad.name: Language, education and culture
broad.description: Papers on large language models and NLP meeting quantum computing, quantum education and workforce, music, and quantum-like models of cognition.

broad.name: Simulation, annealing and ground states
broad.description: Papers on simulating many-body and molecular systems on quantum hardware, adiabatic and annealing algorithms, and classical simulation of noisy circuits.

broad.name: Quantum optimal control
broad.description: Papers that design control fields and pulses for state preparation and gates, analytically, numerically and with robustness to errors.

broad.name: Reinforcement learning
broad.description: Papers that use reinforcement learning to control quantum systems and compile circuits, or build quantum versions of reinforcement-learning agents.

broad.name: Biology and drug discovery
broad.description: Papers that apply quantum optimisation and simulation to protein structure, docking, drug design and genomic sequence problems.

broad.name: Optimisation and scientific computing
broad.description: Papers on QAOA, QUBOs and industrial optimisation, variational-algorithm training, and quantum algorithms for linear algebra and differential equations.

broad.name: Quantum error correction
broad.description: Papers on error-correcting codes, decoders, fault-tolerant gadgets, magic states and error mitigation.

broad.name: Systems, simulators and benchmarks
broad.description: Papers on classical simulators of quantum circuits, compilation and routing, distributed and HPC-integrated execution, and benchmarking of quantum computers.

broad.name: Circuits, compilation and programming
broad.description: Papers on circuit synthesis and decomposition, state preparation, arithmetic and Fourier circuits, Shor's algorithm, programming languages, testing and ZX-calculus.

broad.name: Entanglement and nonlocality
broad.description: Papers that detect, quantify and classify entanglement, and study Bell nonlocality in standard, network and LOCC settings.

broad.name: Entropies, divergences and Markov dynamics
broad.description: Papers on the mathematics of quantum information: entropies and divergences, optimal transport, information geometry, Markov semigroups and non-Markovianity.

broad.name: Quantum information theory
broad.description: Papers on channel capacities, resource theories, magic, discrimination and estimation of states, measurement incompatibility, uncertainty relations and steering.

broad.name: Operator algebras and matrix analysis
broad.description: Papers on the mathematics underlying quantum theory: positive maps, categorical quantum mechanics, majorization and matrix inequalities, and mutually unbiased bases.

broad.name: Quantum walks
broad.description: Papers on discrete- and continuous-time quantum walks: spatial search, spreading and localisation, and state transfer on graphs.

broad.name: Quantum complexity and query algorithms
broad.description: Papers on quantum complexity theory: local Hamiltonian problems, query complexity, Grover search, hidden subgroups, proof systems, nonlocal games and unitary designs.

broad.name: Quantum key distribution
broad.description: Papers on QKD protocols, security proofs and implementations over fibre, free space and satellites, including continuous-variable, device-independent and multiparty schemes.

broad.name: Quantum cryptography and certification
broad.description: Papers on quantum cryptographic primitives, pseudorandomness, delegated and blind computation, privacy, quantum money, randomness generation and device-independent certification.

broad.name: Photonic quantum information
broad.description: Papers on photonic entanglement generation and processing, programmable photonic circuits, quantum memories, fibre networks, timing and optical receivers.

broad.name: Quantum teleportation
broad.description: Papers on teleportation protocols and their fidelity, continuous-variable teleportation, and quantum energy teleportation.

broad.name: Quantum networks and repeaters
broad.description: Papers on quantum internet architecture and simulation, entanglement routing, repeaters, distillation and purification, and satellite entanglement distribution.

broad.name: Estimation, tomography and sampling
broad.description: Papers on parameter estimation and metrology bounds, state and process tomography, classical shadows, phase and amplitude estimation, noise spectroscopy and boson sampling.

broad.name: Nonclassical light and interference
broad.description: Papers on cat, Fock and other non-Gaussian states of light, nonclassicality measures, two-photon interference, wave-particle duality and continuous-variable entanglement criteria.

broad.name: Quantum imaging and remote sensing
broad.description: Papers on quantum illumination, quantum radar and lidar, imaging with correlated and undetected photons, and quantum-limited superresolution.

broad.name: Single-photon detectors
broad.description: Papers that develop and characterise single-photon avalanche diodes and superconducting nanowire detectors, including photon-number resolution.

broad.name: Superconducting circuit hardware
broad.description: Papers that design, fabricate, control and read out superconducting qubits and the microwave circuitry around them.

broad.name: Quantum thermal machines and driven-dissipative control
broad.description: Papers on quantum batteries, heat engines, heat flow, synchronisation, dissipative state preparation and controlled population or state transfer.

broad.name: Semiconductor spin qubits
broad.description: Papers on electron and hole spin qubits in silicon and germanium quantum dots, from materials to gates and automated tuning.

broad.name: Gate implementations across platforms
broad.description: Papers on entangling gates for ions, neutral atoms and photons, trapped-ion architecture, gate robustness methods and bosonic codes.

broad.name: Atomic sensors, clocks and cooling
broad.description: Papers on Rydberg electrometry, atomic magnetometers, optical clocks and the laser cooling and trapping of atoms and ions.

broad.name: Interferometry, levitation and fundamental-physics sensing
broad.description: Papers on dark matter searches, atom and matter-wave interferometry, levitated particles and quantum-enhanced optical interferometers.

broad.name: Nonlinear quantum optics and photon-pair sources
broad.description: Papers on generating squeezed light and entangled photon pairs, structured photons, frequency conversion and entangled two-photon spectroscopy.

broad.name: Quantum dot emitters and free-electron quantum optics
broad.description: Papers on semiconductor quantum dot photon sources and spin-photon interfaces, and on quantum optics with free electron beams.

broad.name: Optomechanics and quantum acoustics
broad.description: Papers on cavity optomechanics, mechanical entanglement and cooling, force sensing, phononic transducers and surface acoustic wave devices.

broad.name: Cavity magnonics
broad.description: Papers on magnons in YIG and other magnets coupled to microwave cavities, mechanics and qubits.

broad.name: Light-matter interaction
broad.description: Papers on cavity and waveguide QED, Rabi and Jaynes-Cummings models, collective emission, polaritons, spin squeezing and strong-field quantum optics.

broad.name: NV centres in diamond
broad.description: Papers on nitrogen-vacancy centre physics and materials, NV magnetometry, and NV and nanodiamond sensing in biology.

broad.name: Solid-state colour centres and emitters
broad.description: Papers on spin defects and quantum emitters in hBN, silicon, silicon carbide and diamond, rare-earth dopants, and excitons in 2D semiconductors.

broad.name: Spin chemistry and magnetic resonance
broad.description: Papers on molecular and nuclear spins, NMR and hyperpolarisation, radical-pair magnetoreception and chirality effects in molecules.

broad.name: Rydberg atom physics and simulation
broad.description: Papers on Rydberg atom arrays as many-body simulators and on controlling Rydberg excitations, states and interactions.

broad.name: Molecular and chemical physics
broad.description: Papers on electronic structure theory, nonadiabatic and ultrafast molecular dynamics, energy transfer, Rydberg molecules and control of cold molecules.

broad.name: Topological and non-Hermitian matter
broad.description: Papers on Majorana modes, Chern and Floquet topological phases, non-Hermitian topology and skin effects, and 2D quantum materials.

broad.name: Quantum many-body phases and gases
broad.description: Papers on quantum phase transitions, spin liquids, Hubbard and Bose-Hubbard models, impurities, Bose-Einstein condensates and many-body transport.

broad.name: Driven systems and ergodicity breaking
broad.description: Papers on Floquet engineering, time crystals, many-body scars, Hilbert space fragmentation and Anderson and many-body localisation.

broad.name: Quantum chaos and operator growth
broad.description: Papers on quantum chaos, scrambling and OTOCs, Krylov complexity, random matrix spectra, SYK models, dual-unitary circuits and cellular automata.

broad.name: Holography and quantum information
broad.description: Papers on holographic error-correcting codes, bulk reconstruction and the holographic entropy cone.

broad.name: Tensor network methods
broad.description: Papers on matrix product states, PEPS and tree tensor networks as tools for many-body simulation.

broad.name: Entanglement, symmetry and topological order
broad.description: Papers on many-body entanglement entropy, symmetry-protected and topological order, anyons, integrability, geometric phases and lattice gauge theory simulation.

broad.name: Vortex beams and twisted particles
broad.description: Papers on electrons, photons and atoms carrying orbital angular momentum and how vortex states interact with matter and fields.

broad.name: Vacuum fluctuations and QED effects
broad.description: Papers on Casimir forces, vacuum fluctuations, Schwinger pair production, bound-state QED corrections and the Aharonov-Bohm effect.

broad.name: Non-Hermitian quantum physics
broad.description: Papers on PT-symmetric and pseudo-Hermitian Hamiltonians, exceptional points and sensing near them.

broad.name: Mathematical quantum mechanics
broad.description: Papers on exactly solvable potentials, relativistic wave equations, scattering theory, phase-space methods, coherent states and few-body problems.

broad.name: Quantum thermodynamics foundations
broad.description: Papers on information thermodynamics and Landauer erasure, entropy production, work statistics and work extraction.

broad.name: Open-system dynamics and thermalisation
broad.description: Papers on master equations, decoherence, thermalisation, Gibbs state preparation, monitored circuits, speed limits, thermometry and time in quantum dynamics.

broad.name: Foundations and interpretation
broad.description: Papers on the structure and interpretation of quantum theory, Bell nonlocality, contextuality, causality, reference frames, Bohmian mechanics and history.

broad.name: Quantum gravity and cosmology interfaces
broad.description: Papers on black holes and Hawking radiation, gravity-induced entanglement, collapse models, quantum clocks, cosmology and minimal-length theories.

broad.name: Quantum information in neutrino physics
broad.description: Papers on coherence and correlations in neutrino oscillations and quantum simulation of collective neutrino flavour dynamics.

broad.name: Relativistic quantum information and particle physics
broad.description: Papers on Unruh-DeWitt detectors, entanglement harvesting, and entanglement and Bell tests in particle scattering and collider events.

fine.name: Quantum state and channel learning
fine.description: Papers that bound the samples and queries needed to learn unknown states, channels and measurements, including shadow tomography and online learning.

fine.name: Machine learning for molecules and materials
fine.description: Papers that combine classical or quantum machine learning with electronic-structure methods to predict molecular energies, potentials and material properties.

fine.name: Quantum PAC learning theory
fine.description: Papers that prove sample-complexity bounds and quantum-classical separations for learning classical concepts in PAC and statistical-query models.

fine.name: Machine-learned entanglement detection
fine.description: Papers that train neural networks and other classifiers to detect, classify or quantify entanglement from partial measurement data.

fine.name: Hamiltonian learning
fine.description: Papers that recover the Hamiltonian or Lindbladian of a many-body system from its dynamics, often with Heisenberg-limited scaling.

fine.name: Machine learning of phases of matter
fine.description: Papers that classify quantum phases and detect phase transitions with supervised, unsupervised or quantum machine learning on many-body data.

fine.name: Neural quantum states
fine.description: Papers that represent many-body wavefunctions with neural networks and optimise them by variational Monte Carlo.

fine.name: Quantum clustering algorithms
fine.description: Papers that give quantum and hybrid algorithms for k-means, spectral and correlation clustering, including coreset constructions with provable speed-ups.

fine.name: Quantum generative models
fine.description: Papers that train quantum circuit Born machines, IQP-based and diffusion-style generative models to learn and sample probability distributions.

fine.name: Quantum generative adversarial networks
fine.description: Papers that design and train quantum and hybrid GANs, mostly for image and tabular data generation, and study mode collapse.

fine.name: Quantum graph neural networks
fine.description: Papers that build quantum and hybrid graph neural networks and quantum graph embeddings for learning on graph-structured data.

fine.name: Quantum reservoir computing
fine.description: Papers that use the fixed dynamics of spin, oscillator and photonic systems as reservoirs for time-series prediction, with trained classical readout.

fine.name: Tensor-network machine learning
fine.description: Papers that use matrix product states and other tensor networks as classifiers and generative models, and study their training.

fine.name: Quantum physics-informed neural networks
fine.description: Papers that solve ordinary and partial differential equations with quantum or hybrid physics-informed neural networks.

fine.name: Geometric quantum machine learning
fine.description: Papers that build symmetry-equivariant quantum neural networks from group representation theory to improve trainability and generalisation.

fine.name: Quantum time-series forecasting
fine.description: Papers that forecast weather, energy and financial time series with quantum LSTMs, variational circuits and other hybrid sequence models.

fine.name: Photonic quantum neural networks
fine.description: Papers that implement neural networks and classifiers on linear-optical and other photonic hardware, classical or quantum.

fine.name: QML security and anomaly detection
fine.description: Papers that study adversarial and backdoor attacks on quantum classifiers, or apply QML to intrusion and anomaly detection.

fine.name: Quantum federated learning
fine.description: Papers that train quantum or hybrid models across distributed clients without sharing data, with privacy and communication constraints.

fine.name: QML for medical data
fine.description: Papers that apply quantum and hybrid classifiers to medical images, clinical records and biomedical signals, mostly as benchmarks against classical models.

fine.name: Quantum kernel methods
fine.description: Papers that build, train and benchmark quantum kernels and quantum support vector machines, including their concentration and scaling.

fine.name: Quantum and hybrid neural networks
fine.description: Papers that design quantum convolutional and hybrid quantum-classical neural networks and test them on image classification benchmarks.

fine.name: Quantum machine learning surveys
fine.description: Papers that review quantum machine learning as a whole: data encoding, model families, hardware readiness and claimed advantages.

fine.name: Variational quantum classifiers
fine.description: Papers that design variational quantum classifiers, especially multiclass schemes, ensembles, data re-uploading and output encodings.

fine.name: QML for financial prediction
fine.description: Papers that apply quantum and hybrid classifiers and regressors to credit risk, fraud detection and stock-return prediction.

fine.name: Option pricing with amplitude estimation
fine.description: Papers that price derivatives and estimate financial risk with quantum amplitude estimation as a quadratic speed-up over Monte Carlo.

fine.name: Portfolio optimisation
fine.description: Papers that cast portfolio selection as QUBO or constrained problems and solve them with QAOA, VQE, annealing and decomposition pipelines.

fine.name: Quantum computer music
fine.description: Papers that compose, synthesise and sonify music and sound with quantum circuits, annealers and quantum data.

fine.name: LLM agents for quantum computing
fine.description: Papers that use large language models and AI agents to write quantum code, design experiments, run hardware and answer physics questions.

fine.name: Quantum natural language processing
fine.description: Papers that build compositional (DisCoCat, DisCoCirc) and attention-based quantum models for text classification and generation.

fine.name: Quantum education and workforce
fine.description: Papers that design and evaluate quantum courses, outreach and training programmes, and survey students, instructors and industry needs.

fine.name: Quantum-like models of cognition
fine.description: Papers that model human decision-making, opinion dynamics and language with quantum probability and open-system formalisms.

fine.name: Compilation for neutral-atom arrays
fine.description: Papers that compile, route and schedule circuits on neutral-atom arrays using atom movement, zoned architectures and native multi-qubit gates.

fine.name: Shortcuts to adiabaticity
fine.description: Papers that speed up adiabatic state transfer and preparation with counterdiabatic driving, invariant-based inverse engineering and related shortcuts.

fine.name: Rydberg arrays for independent sets
fine.description: Papers that encode maximum independent set and other graph problems in Rydberg atom arrays via the blockade, and assess hardness and speed-ups.

fine.name: Classical simulation of noisy circuits
fine.description: Papers that classically simulate or sample from noisy and random quantum circuits (Pauli propagation, frame methods) and locate where advantage can begin.

fine.name: Minor embedding and annealer benchmarks
fine.description: Papers that embed optimisation problems into D-Wave hardware graphs, tune chain strengths and schedules, and benchmark annealer generations.

fine.name: Quantum annealing dynamics
fine.description: Papers that study annealing schedules, energy gaps, diabatic and reverse annealing, catalysts and decoherence in transverse-field Ising annealing.

fine.name: Fermion-to-qubit mappings and Hubbard simulation
fine.description: Papers that design fermion-to-qubit encodings and circuits for simulating Fermi-Hubbard and other fermionic models on digital hardware.

fine.name: Analog and digital-analog simulation
fine.description: Papers that analyse the accuracy, error propagation, verification and programming of analog and digital-analog quantum simulators.

fine.name: Adiabatic quantum computation
fine.description: Papers that analyse adiabatic algorithms for state preparation, optimisation and linear systems, including runtime bounds and discretised adiabatic evolution.

fine.name: Trotter error and product formulas
fine.description: Papers that bound, estimate and reduce Trotter error, and design higher-order, randomised and multi-product formulas for Hamiltonian simulation.

fine.name: Quantum imaginary-time evolution
fine.description: Papers that implement imaginary-time evolution on quantum hardware (QITE, probabilistic and variational variants) to prepare ground and thermal states.

fine.name: Quantum impurity solvers for DMFT
fine.description: Papers that compute Green's functions of Anderson impurity models on quantum hardware as solvers for dynamical mean-field theory.

fine.name: Quantum Krylov and subspace diagonalisation
fine.description: Papers that estimate eigenvalues by projecting Hamiltonians onto quantum-generated Krylov or sampled subspaces, including sample-based Krylov diagonalisation.

fine.name: VQE for lattice and nuclear models
fine.description: Papers that apply variational quantum eigensolvers to Hubbard, Heisenberg and nuclear shell-model Hamiltonians and benchmark ansatz choices.

fine.name: VQE for molecular electronic structure
fine.description: Papers that compute molecular ground and excited states with VQE, ADAPT and related ansatze, and benchmark them for quantum chemistry.

fine.name: Robust quantum optimal control
fine.description: Papers that design control pulses insensitive to drift, model errors and noise, and quantify the cost of that robustness.

fine.name: Quantum optimal control theory
fine.description: Papers that apply Pontryagin's principle, invariants and Krotov-type methods to steer closed and open systems, including incoherent and feedback control.

fine.name: GRAPE and numerical pulse optimisation
fine.description: Papers that develop gradient-based and global numerical solvers and software packages for quantum optimal control problems.

fine.name: Reinforcement learning for quantum control
fine.description: Papers that train reinforcement-learning agents to design pulses, feedback, readout and cooling protocols for quantum devices.

fine.name: Quantum reinforcement learning
fine.description: Papers that build reinforcement-learning agents from variational circuits or quantum subroutines and test them on classical environments.

fine.name: RL for circuit synthesis and compilation
fine.description: Papers that use reinforcement learning to synthesise, optimise and route quantum circuits and to search circuit architectures.

fine.name: Protein folding and drug discovery
fine.description: Papers that map protein folding, side-chain placement, docking and peptide design to QUBOs and variational algorithms.

fine.name: Quantum algorithms for genomics
fine.description: Papers that apply quantum search, annealing and optimisation to sequence alignment, genome assembly, phylogenetics and mRNA design.

fine.name: Quantum continuous optimisation
fine.description: Papers that give quantum algorithms and query bounds for convex, nonconvex and stochastic optimisation, including Hamiltonian descent and interior-point methods.

fine.name: Power-grid optimisation
fine.description: Papers that apply QAOA, annealing and quantum linear solvers to unit commitment, power flow and other electricity-grid problems.

fine.name: Routing, scheduling and logistics
fine.description: Papers that formulate travelling-salesman, vehicle-routing, scheduling and packing problems as QUBOs and solve them with quantum and hybrid solvers.

fine.name: QAOA performance and parameter setting
fine.description: Papers that analyse, train, transfer parameters for and benchmark the quantum approximate optimisation algorithm (QAOA), including constrained mixers.

fine.name: QUBO formulations and solvers
fine.description: Papers that build, compress and encode quadratic unconstrained binary optimisation (QUBO) formulations and benchmark quantum and classical QUBO solvers.

fine.name: QSP, QSVT and block encodings
fine.description: Papers that develop quantum signal processing, singular-value transformation and block encodings as general tools for polynomial transformations of matrices.

fine.name: Quantum linear system solvers
fine.description: Papers that design, optimise and compare HHL and later quantum linear-system algorithms, including variational and quantum-inspired solvers.

fine.name: Quantum algorithms for differential equations
fine.description: Papers that solve linear and nonlinear ODEs and PDEs on quantum computers via Schrödingerisation, Carleman linearisation and variational methods.

fine.name: Quantum lattice Boltzmann and CFD
fine.description: Papers that simulate classical fluid flow on quantum computers, mostly through lattice Boltzmann and Carleman-linearised schemes.

fine.name: Barren plateaus and VQA training
fine.description: Papers that analyse trainability of variational quantum algorithms: barren plateaus, initialisation, gradient estimation and optimisers.

fine.name: Magic state distillation and cultivation
fine.description: Papers that design and cost magic-state distillation, cultivation and injection protocols for fault-tolerant non-Clifford gates.

fine.name: Quantum error mitigation
fine.description: Papers that develop and benchmark zero-noise extrapolation, probabilistic error cancellation, readout correction and other mitigation methods on noisy hardware.

fine.name: Floquet codes
fine.description: Papers that construct and analyse dynamical (Floquet) codes generated by periodic sequences of non-commuting two-qubit measurements.

fine.name: QEC benchmarking and realistic noise
fine.description: Papers that simulate, benchmark and teach quantum error correction under realistic hardware noise such as crosstalk, drift and readout error.

fine.name: Fault-tolerant gadgets and syndrome extraction
fine.description: Papers that design flag-based syndrome extraction, error-detecting codes and low-overhead fault-tolerant state preparation and logic.

fine.name: Surface-code decoders
fine.description: Papers that build matching, belief-propagation and neural-network decoders for surface and colour codes, with attention to real-time latency.

fine.name: Stabilizer code constructions
fine.description: Papers that construct stabilizer and non-stabilizer codes algebraically, including qudit and mixed-dimension codes, and study their structure.

fine.name: Transversal and non-Clifford logical gates
fine.description: Papers that find codes supporting transversal, fold-transversal and constant-depth logical gates, especially non-Clifford gates on CSS and qLDPC codes.

fine.name: Decoders for qLDPC codes
fine.description: Papers that design belief-propagation-based and other decoders for quantum low-density parity-check codes, including bivariate bicycle codes.

fine.name: Low-overhead qLDPC architectures
fine.description: Papers that lay out quantum low-density parity-check codes on realistic hardware connectivity and perform logical operations on them with low overhead.

fine.name: GPU and HPC circuit simulators
fine.description: Papers that build and benchmark state-vector and hybrid circuit simulators on GPUs, supercomputers and other accelerators.

fine.name: Tensor-network circuit simulation
fine.description: Papers that simulate quantum circuits with matrix product states and other tensor networks, and compile tensor networks into shallow circuits.

fine.name: Distributed quantum computing
fine.description: Papers that partition, compile and schedule circuits across networked quantum processors linked by teleported gates and shared entanglement.

fine.name: Circuit cutting
fine.description: Papers that split large circuits into smaller subcircuits by gate and wire cuts and reduce the resulting sampling overhead.

fine.name: Benchmarking quantum computers
fine.description: Papers that define and run application-level and holistic benchmarks such as quantum volume to compare quantum processors and software stacks.

fine.name: Qubit mapping and routing
fine.description: Papers that map logical qubits to hardware and insert SWAPs to satisfy connectivity, with exact, heuristic and benchmarked routers.

fine.name: Quantum-HPC integration and cloud
fine.description: Papers that integrate quantum processors into HPC centres and cloud services: software stacks, scheduling, orchestration and hybrid workflows.

fine.name: Randomized benchmarking
fine.description: Papers that design and analyse randomized benchmarking, cross-entropy and related protocols for estimating gate error rates.

fine.name: Quantum image representation
fine.description: Papers that encode, compress, transform and encrypt classical images in quantum states (FRQI, NEQR and successors).

fine.name: Measurement-based quantum computation
fine.description: Papers that compile circuits into measurement patterns on graph and cluster states, and study flow, universality and MBQC resources.

fine.name: Shor's algorithm and cryptanalysis
fine.description: Papers that implement, optimise and cost Shor-type factoring and discrete-logarithm algorithms, and assess alternative factoring claims.

fine.name: ZX-calculus and graphical languages
fine.description: Papers that develop ZX, ZH and ZXW diagrammatic calculi, prove completeness, and use rewriting for circuits and verification.

fine.name: Quantum Fourier transform circuits
fine.description: Papers that design faster, shallower and hardware-mapped quantum Fourier transform circuits and related transforms.

fine.name: Quantum arithmetic circuits
fine.description: Papers that design adders, multipliers, comparators and modular arithmetic with low Toffoli, T and ancilla counts.

fine.name: Quantum state preparation
fine.description: Papers that prepare arbitrary, sparse and structured quantum states with optimal depth and ancilla trade-offs.

fine.name: Quantum programming languages and verification
fine.description: Papers that design quantum programming languages, intermediate representations and semantics, and formally verify quantum programs.

fine.name: Quantum software testing and debugging
fine.description: Papers that test, debug and study bugs in quantum programs, libraries and simulators with software-engineering methods.

fine.name: Multi-controlled gate decomposition
fine.description: Papers that decompose multi-controlled and general unitaries into CNOTs and single-qubit gates with fewer gates or lower depth.

fine.name: Clifford+T synthesis and circuit optimisation
fine.description: Papers that synthesise and optimise circuits over Clifford+T and other gate sets, minimising T-count, CNOT count and depth.

fine.name: Graph and hypergraph states
fine.description: Papers that classify and construct graph and hypergraph states and relate their entanglement to graph-theoretic structure such as vertex-minors.

fine.name: Entanglement monogamy relations
fine.description: Papers that derive tighter monogamy and polygamy inequalities for concurrence, negativity and other entanglement measures in multi-qubit systems.

fine.name: Nonlocality without entanglement
fine.description: Papers that construct sets of orthogonal product states that cannot be distinguished by local operations and classical communication (LOCC).

fine.name: Entanglement detection and measures
fine.description: Papers that derive separability criteria, entanglement witnesses and measures for bipartite and multipartite states, including moment-based tests.

fine.name: Local-unitary invariants and AME states
fine.description: Papers that classify multipartite entanglement by local-unitary invariants and construct absolutely maximally entangled states and perfect tensors.

fine.name: Bell inequalities and nonlocality
fine.description: Papers that construct and optimise Bell inequalities, quantify nonlocality, and study sequential sharing of Bell violations.

fine.name: Network nonlocality
fine.description: Papers that study nonlocal correlations in networks with independent sources, such as triangle and bilocal networks.

fine.name: Quantum optimal transport
fine.description: Papers that define quantum Wasserstein distances and optimal-transport costs between states and channels and prove their metric properties.

fine.name: Information geometry and wavefunction entropies
fine.description: Papers that study metrics on quantum state space, or compute Shannon, Fisher and Rényi entropies for exactly solvable potentials.

fine.name: Quantum Markov semigroups and dynamical maps
fine.description: Papers that characterise completely positive dynamical maps, Markov semigroups, their generators, divisibility and relaxation rates.

fine.name: Quantum non-Markovianity
fine.description: Papers that define, witness and quantify memory effects in open quantum dynamics, including multi-time processes and quantum versus classical memory.

fine.name: Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobability
fine.description: Papers that study Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobability distributions, their nonpositivity and links to weak values, coherence and quantum advantage.

fine.name: Quantum relative entropies and divergences
fine.description: Papers that prove continuity, data-processing and operational results for von Neumann, Rényi and f-divergence quantities.

fine.name: Magic and stabilizer Rényi entropy
fine.description: Papers that quantify nonstabilizerness (magic) with stabilizer Rényi entropies and other monotones, especially in many-body states and circuits.

fine.name: Purification, cloning and channel supermaps
fine.description: Papers that bound and construct protocols for purifying, cloning, storing and transforming unknown states and channels, including the random purification channel.

fine.name: Fidelity and trace-distance estimation
fine.description: Papers that give sample- and query-optimal algorithms for estimating fidelity, trace distance, purity and state-power traces.

fine.name: General quantum resource theories
fine.description: Papers that develop the general framework of quantum resource theories: monotones, robustness, convertibility and dynamical resources.

fine.name: Coherence and imaginarity resource theories
fine.description: Papers that quantify quantum coherence and imaginarity as resources and relate them to metrology, algorithms and state transformations.

fine.name: Channel capacities and quantum Shannon theory
fine.description: Papers that bound classical and quantum capacities of channels, prove achievability and converse results, and study communication complexity.

fine.name: Measurement incompatibility
fine.description: Papers that characterise, quantify and certify incompatibility of measurements and instruments and its role in operational tasks.

fine.name: Uncertainty relations
fine.description: Papers that derive tighter variance-based, entropic and skew-information uncertainty relations, including memory-assisted versions.

fine.name: EPR steering
fine.description: Papers that detect, quantify and share Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen steering in bipartite, multipartite and network scenarios.

fine.name: State and channel discrimination
fine.description: Papers that find optimal minimum-error, unambiguous and sequential strategies for discriminating quantum states and channels, and their limits.

fine.name: Categorical quantum mechanics
fine.description: Papers that formalise quantum processes, supermaps and subsystems with monoidal, dagger and Markov categories and linear logic.

fine.name: Mutually unbiased bases
fine.description: Papers that construct, classify and bound sets of mutually unbiased bases and complex Hadamard matrices, especially in dimension six.

fine.name: Majorization and matrix inequalities
fine.description: Papers that prove majorization relations, norm and trace inequalities and related results in matrix analysis used in quantum information.

fine.name: Positive and completely positive maps
fine.description: Papers that characterise positive, k-positive and completely positive maps on matrix and operator algebras, including Choi-type maps and dilations.

fine.name: Quantum walk spatial search
fine.description: Papers that design and analyse spatial search for marked vertices with coined, Szegedy and continuous-time quantum walks on graphs.

fine.name: Discrete-time quantum walk dynamics
fine.description: Papers that study spreading, localisation, decoherence and entanglement of coined and continuous-time quantum walks on lattices.

fine.name: Perfect state transfer on graphs
fine.description: Papers that characterise perfect and pretty good state transfer of quantum walks on graph families using spectral graph theory.

fine.name: Local Hamiltonian complexity
fine.description: Papers that classify the complexity of ground-state and Gibbs-state problems for local Hamiltonians and give classical approximation algorithms.

fine.name: Quantum topological data analysis
fine.description: Papers that estimate Betti numbers and persistent homology with quantum algorithms and prove hardness results for these tasks.

fine.name: Hidden subgroup and group problems
fine.description: Papers that solve hidden subgroup, isomorphism and representation-theoretic problems over groups with quantum algorithms, and bound their complexity.

fine.name: Nonlocal games and quantum game theory
fine.description: Papers that analyse quantum strategies in nonlocal games such as CHSH and magic square, or quantise classical games with Nash equilibria.

fine.name: Quantum graph algorithms
fine.description: Papers that give quantum query and time bounds for graph problems such as cuts, cycles, triangles and treewidth.

fine.name: Unitary designs and pseudorandom unitaries
fine.description: Papers that construct approximate unitary t-designs and pseudorandom unitaries from shallow random circuits, including under symmetries.

fine.name: Grover search and amplitude amplification
fine.description: Papers that modify, implement and analyse Grover's search and amplitude amplification, including deterministic, qudit and NISQ variants.

fine.name: Quantum query complexity
fine.description: Papers that prove quantum query upper and lower bounds and separations for Boolean functions, search problems and adaptivity.

fine.name: QMA and quantum proof systems
fine.description: Papers that study QMA, QCMA, quantum PCPs and interactive proofs, including oracle separations and complexity-class collapses.

fine.name: Quantum secret sharing
fine.description: Papers that design threshold and other quantum secret sharing schemes, their codes, access structures and rates.

fine.name: Multiparty and semi-quantum key protocols
fine.description: Papers that propose conference key agreement, semi-quantum key distribution, quantum dialogue and anonymous multiparty key protocols.

fine.name: Satellite and free-space QKD
fine.description: Papers that model and demonstrate quantum key distribution over satellite downlinks and terrestrial free-space links, including turbulence and scheduling.

fine.name: QKD information reconciliation
fine.description: Papers that design LDPC, polar and other error-correction schemes for reconciling keys in discrete- and continuous-variable QKD.

fine.name: Twin-field and MDI QKD
fine.description: Papers that implement and extend twin-field and measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution for long distances and networks.

fine.name: Continuous-variable QKD
fine.description: Papers that develop and demonstrate continuous-variable QKD with Gaussian and discrete modulation, local local oscillators and composable security.

fine.name: Practical QKD security and attacks
fine.description: Papers that prove finite-key security of practical decoy-state QKD and analyse source and detector imperfections and attacks.

fine.name: Device-independent QKD
fine.description: Papers that bound key rates and prove security of device-independent quantum key distribution based on Bell violations.

fine.name: Quantum differential privacy
fine.description: Papers that define and analyse differential privacy and related privacy notions for quantum states, channels and algorithms.

fine.name: Private distributed quantum sensing
fine.description: Papers that estimate global functions with networks of quantum sensors while keeping local parameters private or secure against eavesdroppers.

fine.name: Quantum money, blockchain and voting
fine.description: Papers that design quantum money and tokens, quantum or post-quantum blockchains, Byzantine agreement and voting protocols, and assess quantum threats to cryptocurrencies.

fine.name: Blind and delegated quantum computation
fine.description: Papers that let clients delegate quantum computations to untrusted servers with blindness, verifiability or homomorphic encryption.

fine.name: Quantum cryptographic primitives
fine.description: Papers that construct and separate quantum cryptographic primitives such as commitments, oblivious transfer, unclonable and one-shot signatures, and one-way state generators.

fine.name: Pseudorandom states and unitaries
fine.description: Papers that construct, separate and bound pseudorandom quantum states, function-like states and unitaries as cryptographic primitives.

fine.name: Certified quantum randomness
fine.description: Papers that certify and bound randomness in device-independent and semi-device-independent scenarios, including guessing probabilities.

fine.name: Quantum random number generators
fine.description: Papers that build and characterise quantum random number generators from vacuum noise, phase noise and other sources, including source-independent designs.

fine.name: Self-testing of states and measurements
fine.description: Papers that self-test entangled states and measurements from observed correlations, in Bell and prepare-and-measure scenarios.

fine.name: Quantum-limited optical receivers
fine.description: Papers that design receivers approaching the Helstrom and Holevo limits for coherent-state optical communication, including joint-detection schemes.

fine.name: Entanglement distribution over deployed fibre
fine.description: Papers that distribute polarisation and other entanglement over metropolitan fibre networks, including coexistence with classical traffic.

fine.name: Quantum time synchronisation
fine.description: Papers that synchronise clocks and transfer time over fibre and free space with entangled photons and quantum network protocols.

fine.name: Optical quantum memories
fine.description: Papers that store and retrieve photonic qubits in atomic, rare-earth and integrated memories, with attention to efficiency, lifetime and multimode capacity.

fine.name: Heralded photonic entanglement
fine.description: Papers that generate and measure Bell, GHZ and high-dimensional entangled photon states with linear optics and heralding.

fine.name: Photonic cluster states and fusion
fine.description: Papers that generate photonic graph and cluster states from emitters or linear optics and build fusion-based fault-tolerant architectures.

fine.name: Programmable photonic processors
fine.description: Papers that design, characterise and benchmark reconfigurable integrated interferometer meshes and photonic processors for quantum light.

fine.name: Frequency-bin photonic qudits
fine.description: Papers that generate and manipulate frequency-bin entangled photons and qudits on chips with microresonators and electro-optic gates.

fine.name: Quantum energy teleportation
fine.description: Papers that extract energy remotely from entangled many-body ground states using local measurements and classical communication.

fine.name: Teleportation protocols and fidelity
fine.description: Papers that design teleportation protocols (qudit, bidirectional, port-based, noisy) and analyse their fidelity and resource requirements.

fine.name: Continuous-variable teleportation
fine.description: Papers that teleport continuous-variable and hybrid states using squeezed, photon-subtracted and other non-Gaussian entangled resources.

fine.name: Entanglement distillation protocols
fine.description: Papers that design and bound protocols converting many noisy entangled pairs into fewer high-fidelity pairs by local operations.

fine.name: Entanglement purification in networks
fine.description: Papers that analyse and optimise entanglement purification within network operation, including memory decoherence, buffering and asymmetric inputs.

fine.name: Satellite entanglement distribution
fine.description: Papers that model satellite and high-altitude platform architectures for global entanglement distribution and quantum internet backbones.

fine.name: Quantum internet architecture and simulators
fine.description: Papers that propose quantum network stacks and architectures and build discrete-event simulators and software for designing them.

fine.name: Entanglement routing
fine.description: Papers that route bipartite and multipartite entanglement across network topologies with multipath and graph-state methods.

fine.name: Quantum repeater chains
fine.description: Papers that analyse rates and fidelity of memory-based and all-photonic quantum repeaters with entanglement swapping and multiplexing.

fine.name: Boson sampling
fine.description: Papers that analyse the hardness, classical simulation and experimental validation of boson sampling and Gaussian boson sampling.

fine.name: Qubit noise spectroscopy
fine.description: Papers that measure and model the spectra and correlations of qubit dephasing noise with pulse sequences and repeated Ramsey measurements.

fine.name: Quantum amplitude estimation
fine.description: Papers that design low-depth, maximum-likelihood, Bayesian and parallel variants of quantum amplitude estimation.

fine.name: Quantum parameter estimation theory
fine.description: Papers that derive quantum Cramér-Rao and Bayesian bounds, multiparameter limits and optimal strategies for quantum metrology, including under noise.

fine.name: Classical shadows
fine.description: Papers that develop and analyse classical-shadow protocols for predicting many observables from randomised measurements, including process and fermionic shadows.

fine.name: Quantum state and process tomography
fine.description: Papers that reconstruct quantum states, processes and measurements from data, with adaptive, compressed and noise-aware tomography methods.

fine.name: Quantum phase estimation
fine.description: Papers that design and cost quantum phase estimation variants, especially low-depth and statistical versions for early fault-tolerant ground-state energy estimation.

fine.name: Optical cat and Fock state generation
fine.description: Papers that prepare Schrödinger cat, Fock and other non-Gaussian states of light and bosonic modes, often by heralded photon subtraction.

fine.name: Nonclassicality and non-Gaussianity of light
fine.description: Papers that quantify and detect nonclassicality, Wigner negativity and non-Gaussianity of optical states, including photon-added and subtracted states.

fine.name: Hong-Ou-Mandel interference
fine.description: Papers that study two-photon and multi-photon interference, indistinguishability and Hong-Ou-Mandel effects in theory and experiment.

fine.name: Wave-particle duality and complementarity
fine.description: Papers that test and quantify wave-particle duality, which-path information, quantum erasers and complementarity in interferometers.

fine.name: Continuous-variable entanglement criteria
fine.description: Papers that derive entanglement witnesses and separability criteria for Gaussian and non-Gaussian continuous-variable states.

fine.name: Quantum illumination
fine.description: Papers that analyse entanglement-enhanced target detection with two-mode squeezed light in noisy, lossy environments, and its receivers and limits.

fine.name: Quantum radar and lidar
fine.description: Papers that model and demonstrate quantum-enhanced radar and lidar for ranging, velocity estimation and jamming resistance.

fine.name: Ghost imaging and undetected photons
fine.description: Papers that image with photon-pair correlations: ghost imaging, imaging with undetected photons, quantum OCT and entangled-photon microscopy.

fine.name: Superresolution by mode demultiplexing
fine.description: Papers that resolve incoherent point sources below the Rayleigh limit with spatial-mode demultiplexing and quantum-limited estimation.

fine.name: Single-photon avalanche diodes
fine.description: Papers that design, model and calibrate SPAD and InGaAs single-photon detectors, including dark counts, afterpulsing and efficiency.

fine.name: Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors
fine.description: Papers that develop SNSPDs and arrays with high efficiency, low jitter, mid-infrared response and photon-number resolution.

fine.name: Electrons on helium and neon
fine.description: Papers that trap and control single electrons on liquid helium or solid neon surfaces as qubits.

fine.name: Microwave-optical transduction
fine.description: Papers that convert quantum signals between microwave and optical frequencies to link superconducting qubits over distance.

fine.name: Single microwave photon detection
fine.description: Papers that detect, count and generate single itinerant microwave photons using superconducting circuits.

fine.name: Josephson parametric amplifiers
fine.description: Papers that build Josephson and travelling-wave parametric amplifiers for near quantum-limited microwave amplification.

fine.name: Cryogenic control electronics and wiring
fine.description: Papers that develop cryogenic electronics, wiring, filtering and calibrated measurement setups for millikelvin quantum devices.

fine.name: Superconducting circuit quantisation
fine.description: Papers that derive Hamiltonians for superconducting circuits from lumped-element or electromagnetic models of their environment.

fine.name: Dispersive readout and Purcell filters
fine.description: Papers that speed up and improve dispersive readout of superconducting qubits, often with Purcell filters protecting coherence.

fine.name: Quasiparticles and radiation-induced errors
fine.description: Papers that measure and mitigate quasiparticle poisoning and correlated errors from cosmic rays and radioactivity in superconducting qubits.

fine.name: Superconducting qubit gates and couplers
fine.description: Papers that design two-qubit gates, tunable couplers and crosstalk suppression for transmon and fluxonium processors.

fine.name: Superconducting materials and fabrication
fine.description: Papers that improve films, junctions, substrates and fabrication steps to cut loss in superconducting resonators and qubits.

fine.name: Two-level system defects
fine.description: Papers that characterise microscopic two-level system defects and their effect on superconducting qubit coherence and stability.

fine.name: Qubit control systems and calibration
fine.description: Papers that build FPGA and RFSoC control stacks and software for calibrating and running superconducting qubits.

fine.name: Quantum batteries
fine.description: Papers that model charging, storage and work extraction (ergotropy) in quantum batteries and look for collective charging advantages.

fine.name: Quantum synchronisation
fine.description: Papers that study synchronisation of quantum self-sustained oscillators and spins, including van der Pol models and experiments.

fine.name: Dissipative entanglement stabilisation
fine.description: Papers that use engineered dissipation and reservoirs to prepare and stabilise entangled steady states of qubits.

fine.name: Spin-chain quantum state transfer
fine.description: Papers that design spin-chain couplings and protocols for perfect or high-fidelity transfer of quantum states.

fine.name: Kerr-cat and bosonic oscillator qubits
fine.description: Papers that control Kerr parametric oscillators, cat qubits and nonlinear bosonic modes, including multiphoton dissipation and gates.

fine.name: STIRAP and adiabatic population transfer
fine.description: Papers that design stimulated Raman adiabatic passage and related pulse schemes for population transfer in multilevel systems.

fine.name: Quantum heat engines and refrigerators
fine.description: Papers that analyse Otto cycles and other quantum heat engines and refrigerators for power, efficiency and fluctuations.

fine.name: Quantum heat transport and rectification
fine.description: Papers that control heat currents between quantum baths with thermal diodes, valves, transistors and superconducting circuits.

fine.name: Automated quantum dot tuning
fine.description: Papers that automate the tuning and characterisation of quantum dot devices, often with machine learning on charge stability diagrams.

fine.name: Silicon spin qubit control
fine.description: Papers that demonstrate and model gates, readout, shuttling and noise for spin qubits in silicon and germanium quantum dots.

fine.name: Valley splitting and hole spins
fine.description: Papers that model valley splitting, g-tensors and spin-orbit effects in Si/SiGe and germanium hole spin qubits.

fine.name: Geometric and holonomic quantum gates
fine.description: Papers that design nonadiabatic geometric and holonomic gates and make them robust to control errors.

fine.name: Photon-photon and photonic gate schemes
fine.description: Papers that propose deterministic or heralded gates between photonic qubits, often mediated by emitters or cavities.

fine.name: Dynamical decoupling
fine.description: Papers that design and test dynamical decoupling sequences to suppress decoherence and crosstalk during idling and gates.

fine.name: Rydberg gates for neutral atoms
fine.description: Papers that design and demonstrate Rydberg-blockade entangling gates and control for neutral-atom quantum computers.

fine.name: Trapped-ion entangling gates
fine.description: Papers that design and demonstrate high-fidelity two-qubit gates on trapped ions using lasers, microwaves or motional modes.

fine.name: Trapped-ion QCCD architecture and shuttling
fine.description: Papers that compile, schedule and architect shuttling-based trapped-ion quantum computers with multiple zones.

fine.name: Ion trap design and fabrication
fine.description: Papers that design, simulate and fabricate surface-electrode, 3D and Penning traps for trapped-ion quantum computing.

fine.name: GKP and bosonic error-correcting codes
fine.description: Papers that analyse, prepare and decode Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill, cat and other bosonic codes.

fine.name: Rydberg-atom electrometry
fine.description: Papers that use Rydberg atoms in vapour cells as sensitive receivers and sensors of radio-frequency and microwave electric fields.

fine.name: Optically pumped atomic magnetometers
fine.description: Papers that build and model alkali vapour magnetometers and comagnetometers, including SERF and squeezed-light schemes.

fine.name: Neutral atom trapping and tweezer loading
fine.description: Papers that cool, load and image neutral atoms in magneto-optical traps, optical tweezers and lattices.

fine.name: Atomic clocks
fine.description: Papers that build and evaluate optical and microwave atomic clocks, their systematic shifts and frequency comparisons.

fine.name: Trapped-ion laser cooling
fine.description: Papers that cool, measure the temperature of and control motional modes of trapped ions and ion crystals.

fine.name: Quantum sensors for dark matter
fine.description: Papers that propose and run searches for axions, dark photons and ultralight dark matter with qubits, spins and other quantum sensors.

fine.name: Macroscopic spatial superpositions
fine.description: Papers that plan Stern-Gerlach and matter-wave interferometers to put massive nanoparticles into spatial superpositions.

fine.name: Atom interferometry techniques
fine.description: Papers that develop Bragg, Raman and Floquet atom optics and pulse sequences for more sensitive atom interferometers.

fine.name: Atom-interferometric inertial sensors
fine.description: Papers that build atom gravimeters, accelerometers and gyroscopes for field, space and long-baseline use.

fine.name: Magnetic levitation of particles
fine.description: Papers that magnetically levitate superconductors, magnets and microparticles for precision force, gravity and rotation sensing.

fine.name: Gravitational-wave detector quantum noise
fine.description: Papers that reduce quantum noise in gravitational-wave and other large interferometers with squeezing and readout schemes.

fine.name: Optically levitated nanoparticles
fine.description: Papers that trap, cool and squeeze optically levitated nanoparticles for force sensing and macroscopic quantum tests.

fine.name: Quantum-enhanced interferometric phase estimation
fine.description: Papers that compute phase sensitivity of Mach-Zehnder and SU(1,1) interferometers with squeezed, NOON and non-Gaussian states.

fine.name: Entangled two-photon absorption spectroscopy
fine.description: Papers that test and model entangled two-photon absorption and other spectroscopy driven by entangled photon pairs.

fine.name: Orbital angular momentum photons
fine.description: Papers that generate, transform and measure photons and entanglement carrying orbital angular momentum and other spatial modes.

fine.name: Squeezed light generation
fine.description: Papers that generate, characterise and engineer squeezed light from optical parametric oscillators, waveguides and microcombs.

fine.name: Quantum metasurface photon sources
fine.description: Papers that generate and shape entangled photon pairs with nonlinear metasurfaces and thin films.

fine.name: Spatio-temporal SPDC theory
fine.description: Papers that model and characterise the spatial and spectral structure of biphotons from spontaneous parametric down-conversion.

fine.name: Integrated photon-pair sources
fine.description: Papers that build bright entangled photon-pair sources on lithium niobate and other integrated photonic chips.

fine.name: Quantum frequency conversion
fine.description: Papers that convert single photons between emitter wavelengths and telecom bands with low added noise.

fine.name: Quantum dot spin-photon interfaces
fine.description: Papers that control optically active electron and hole spins in quantum dots and entangle them with emitted photons.

fine.name: Quantum electron microscopy and beam shaping
fine.description: Papers that shape free-electron beams with light and bring quantum methods to transmission electron microscopy and imaging.

fine.name: Free electron-photon interactions
fine.description: Papers that study entanglement and quantum state preparation through interactions between free electrons and photons or emitters.

fine.name: Quantum dot excitation and photon cascades
fine.description: Papers that model and demonstrate excitation schemes and biexciton cascades for entangled photons from quantum dots.

fine.name: Quantum dot single-photon sources
fine.description: Papers that build bright, indistinguishable single-photon sources from semiconductor quantum dots in cavities and waveguides.

fine.name: Piezo-optomechanical transducers
fine.description: Papers that design optomechanical crystals and piezoelectric devices to convert quantum signals between microwaves, phonons and light.

fine.name: Quantum acoustics with superconducting qubits
fine.description: Papers that couple superconducting qubits to surface and bulk acoustic wave resonators and itinerant phonons.

fine.name: Optomechanical entanglement and squeezing
fine.description: Papers that propose schemes to entangle mechanical modes with light or each other and to squeeze mechanical motion.

fine.name: Optomechanical force sensing
fine.description: Papers that push optomechanical force and displacement sensing beyond the standard quantum limit with squeezing and backaction evasion.

fine.name: Optomechanical cooling and control
fine.description: Papers that cool and control mechanical resonators through cavity backaction, feedback and engineered optomechanical coupling.

fine.name: Cavity magnomechanics
fine.description: Papers that propose entanglement, squeezing and nonreciprocity in systems coupling magnons, phonons and cavity photons.

fine.name: Magnon-photon coupling
fine.description: Papers that measure and engineer coupling between magnons and microwave or optical cavity photons, including magnon polaritons.

fine.name: Quantum magnonics with qubits
fine.description: Papers that create nonclassical magnon states such as blockade, squeezing and cat states using qubits coupled to magnons.

fine.name: Quantum optics of high-harmonic generation
fine.description: Papers that treat high-harmonic generation and strong-field processes quantum optically, including driving with squeezed or nonclassical light.

fine.name: Photon blockade and nonreciprocity
fine.description: Papers that engineer photon blockade, antibunching and nonreciprocal transmission in cavities and hybrid systems.

fine.name: Spin squeezing
fine.description: Papers that generate spin-squeezed states with one-axis twisting, cavities and dipolar interactions for quantum-enhanced metrology.

fine.name: Jaynes-Cummings model dynamics
fine.description: Papers that solve generalised Jaynes-Cummings models for atom-field dynamics, entanglement and nonclassical field states.

fine.name: Quantum Rabi models
fine.description: Papers that analyse quantum Rabi models and their variants, including deep strong coupling and superradiant phase transitions.

fine.name: Molecular polaritons and polaritonic chemistry
fine.description: Papers that model molecules strongly coupled to optical cavities and how polaritons change spectra and chemical dynamics.

fine.name: Ultrastrong light-matter coupling
fine.description: Papers that develop theory for cavity QED in the ultrastrong regime and cavity control of quantum materials.

fine.name: Superradiance and subradiance
fine.description: Papers that study collective super- and subradiant emission from atomic arrays, ensembles and emitter collectives.

fine.name: Waveguide QED and giant atoms
fine.description: Papers that model emitters and giant atoms coupled to waveguides and structured baths, including bound states and non-Markovian dynamics.

fine.name: NV centre materials and photophysics
fine.description: Papers that create NV centres and study their charge states, spin readout and photophysics in diamond.

fine.name: NV and nanodiamond biosensing
fine.description: Papers that use NV centres and fluorescent nanodiamonds for relaxometry, thermometry and spin detection in cells and biological samples.

fine.name: NV-centre magnetometry
fine.description: Papers that build and improve NV-centre magnetometers, from single-spin scanning probes to ensemble and microwave field sensors.

fine.name: Boron-vacancy spin defects in hBN
fine.description: Papers that characterise and control boron-vacancy and other spin defects in hexagonal boron nitride for sensing.

fine.name: Quantum emitters in hBN
fine.description: Papers that create and characterise single-photon emitters in hexagonal boron nitride and study their coherence and spectra.

fine.name: Rare-earth ions in solids
fine.description: Papers that study erbium, europium and other rare-earth dopants in crystals as optical spin qubits, photon sources and memories.

fine.name: Colour centres in silicon
fine.description: Papers that develop T, G and other telecom colour centres in silicon as spin-photon interfaces.

fine.name: Spin defects in silicon carbide
fine.description: Papers that characterise vacancy and divacancy spin defects in silicon carbide and integrate them with devices and cavities.

fine.name: Group-IV diamond centres in nanophotonics
fine.description: Papers that couple tin-, silicon- and germanium-vacancy centres in diamond to cavities and photonic circuits as spin-photon interfaces.

fine.name: Excitons in 2D semiconductors
fine.description: Papers that model and measure excitons, trions and polaritons in transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers and moiré heterostructures.

fine.name: Radical-pair magnetoreception
fine.description: Papers that model the radical-pair mechanism behind avian magnetoreception and other biological magnetic field effects.

fine.name: Molecular spin qubits
fine.description: Papers that design molecular electron spins and single-molecule magnets as qubits, qudits and quantum sensors.

fine.name: NMR and nuclear hyperpolarisation
fine.description: Papers that develop NMR methods, dynamic nuclear polarisation and parahydrogen hyperpolarisation, often with quantum sensors.

fine.name: Chirality-induced spin selectivity
fine.description: Papers that explain and model chirality-induced spin selectivity in chiral molecules, junctions and nanowires.

fine.name: Enantiomer detection and separation
fine.description: Papers that use cyclic three-level transitions, laser pulses and cavities to detect and separate chiral molecule enantiomers.

fine.name: Rydberg many-body dynamics
fine.description: Papers that study non-equilibrium and dissipative many-body dynamics of interacting Rydberg atoms and ions.

fine.name: Rydberg state control and interfaces
fine.description: Papers that prepare, image and control Rydberg excitations, circular states and Rydberg-photon interfaces in arrays and ensembles.

fine.name: Rydberg array quantum phases
fine.description: Papers that map ground-state phases of Rydberg atom arrays, such as dimer, spin-liquid and supersolid phases.

fine.name: Photosynthetic and excitonic energy transfer
fine.description: Papers that model coherent exciton and energy transfer in light-harvesting complexes and molecular aggregates with open-system methods.

fine.name: Ultrafast and strong-field molecular dynamics
fine.description: Papers that simulate and image attosecond and femtosecond electron and nuclear dynamics in molecules after ionisation or laser excitation.

fine.name: Ultralong-range Rydberg molecules
fine.description: Papers that study trilobite, butterfly and macrodimer Rydberg molecules and Rydberg interactions with polar molecules.

fine.name: Molecular rotation and orientation control
fine.description: Papers that use shaped laser pulses to orient, align and control the rotational and vibrational states of molecules.

fine.name: Cold molecule spectroscopy and precision tests
fine.description: Papers that trap, cool and probe molecules and molecular ions for precision spectroscopy and electron EDM searches.

fine.name: Nonadiabatic molecular dynamics methods
fine.description: Papers that develop surface hopping, exact factorisation and ring-polymer methods for coupled electron-nuclear dynamics.

fine.name: Electronic structure theory
fine.description: Papers that develop density functional, reduced density matrix and coupled-cluster methods for electronic structure calculations.

fine.name: Magnetic and optical skyrmions
fine.description: Papers that study quantum skyrmions in magnets and optical fields, including skyrmion qubits and topological noise robustness.

fine.name: Majorana zero modes
fine.description: Papers that model, detect and braid Majorana zero modes in Kitaev chains, nanowires and quantum simulators.

fine.name: Chern insulators and fractional Hall states
fine.description: Papers that study Chern insulators, fractional quantum Hall and fractional Chern states, their invariants and edges.

fine.name: Graphene and twisted bilayers
fine.description: Papers that model electronic bands, topology and correlations in graphene, twisted bilayer graphene and moiré systems.

fine.name: Van der Waals magnets and spintronics
fine.description: Papers that study magnetic topological insulators, van der Waals magnets, spin textures and spin-orbit torque in layered materials.

fine.name: Non-Hermitian band topology
fine.description: Papers that classify non-Hermitian topological phases, invariants and bulk-boundary correspondence beyond the skin effect.

fine.name: Non-Hermitian skin effect
fine.description: Papers that analyse and observe the non-Hermitian skin effect, where bulk eigenstates pile up at boundaries.

fine.name: Topological pumping and photonic edge states
fine.description: Papers that study SSH models, topological pumping and edge states in photonic, atomic and quantum optical lattices.

fine.name: Floquet topological phases
fine.description: Papers that study topological phases of periodically driven systems, including anomalous Floquet phases and their detection.

fine.name: Kondo and quantum impurity models
fine.description: Papers that solve Kondo and Anderson impurity models and their real-time dynamics with numerical and analytical methods.

fine.name: Dicke model phase transitions
fine.description: Papers that analyse superradiant and dissipative phase transitions in Dicke models and their generalisations.

fine.name: Quantum spin liquids and frustrated magnets
fine.description: Papers that study spin liquids, Kitaev magnets and frustrated lattice models, including their realisation on quantum simulators.

fine.name: Quantum and dynamical phase transitions
fine.description: Papers that study equilibrium, excited-state and dynamical quantum phase transitions, mostly in Ising-type spin chains.

fine.name: Kibble-Zurek defect formation
fine.description: Papers that test Kibble-Zurek scaling of defects created when quenching across a quantum phase transition.

fine.name: Hubbard models and superconductivity
fine.description: Papers that study Fermi-Hubbard and t-J models, doping, pairing and magnetism in materials and cold-atom simulators.

fine.name: Bose-Hubbard phases
fine.description: Papers that map superfluid, Mott and density-wave phases of Bose-Hubbard and dipolar boson lattice models.

fine.name: Polarons and impurities in quantum gases
fine.description: Papers that study Bose and Fermi polarons and mobile impurities immersed in ultracold gases.

fine.name: Bose-Einstein condensate dynamics
fine.description: Papers that model Bose-Einstein condensates, superfluidity, vortices and turbulence in quantum gases.

fine.name: Quantum droplets and dipolar supersolids
fine.description: Papers that study quantum droplets, supersolids and dipolar Bose gases beyond mean field.

fine.name: Many-body transport and hydrodynamics
fine.description: Papers that study diffusive, superdiffusive and KPZ transport and emergent hydrodynamics in quantum spin and fermion chains.

fine.name: Floquet engineering
fine.description: Papers that model and engineer periodically driven quantum systems, including effective Hamiltonians, prethermalisation and dissipation.

fine.name: Time crystals
fine.description: Papers that study discrete, continuous and dissipative time crystals and observe them on quantum devices.

fine.name: Quantum many-body scars
fine.description: Papers that construct and observe many-body scar states that avoid thermalisation, such as in the PXP model.

fine.name: Hilbert space fragmentation
fine.description: Papers that study how kinetic constraints and symmetries fragment Hilbert space and slow thermalisation.

fine.name: Many-body and Anderson localisation
fine.description: Papers that study Anderson and many-body localisation transitions in disordered spin chains, circuits and graphs.

fine.name: Quasiperiodic localisation and mobility edges
fine.description: Papers that find mobility edges and reentrant localisation in quasiperiodic and non-Hermitian lattices.

fine.name: Quantum cellular automata
fine.description: Papers that build quantum and probabilistic cellular automata and relate them to Dirac dynamics and field theories.

fine.name: Krylov complexity and operator growth
fine.description: Papers that use Krylov complexity, Lanczos coefficients and spread complexity to characterise operator and state growth.

fine.name: Dual-unitary circuits
fine.description: Papers that use dual-unitary and space-time dual circuits as exactly solvable models of chaotic many-body dynamics.

fine.name: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev models
fine.description: Papers that study chaos, thermodynamics and holographic features of SYK models and their sparse and open variants.

fine.name: Quantum billiards
fine.description: Papers that compare classical and quantum chaos in billiards through spectral statistics, eigenstates and OTOCs.

fine.name: Information scrambling and OTOCs
fine.description: Papers that measure information scrambling with out-of-time-ordered correlators and Loschmidt echoes in closed and open systems.

fine.name: Random matrix spectral statistics
fine.description: Papers that use random matrix theory, level spacings and spectral form factors to diagnose quantum chaos.

fine.name: Semiclassical and dissipative chaos
fine.description: Papers that relate classical chaos and Lyapunov exponents to quantum behaviour in kicked, few-body and dissipative systems.

fine.name: Holographic codes and bulk reconstruction
fine.description: Papers that model AdS/CFT bulk reconstruction with holographic error-correcting codes and random tensor networks.

fine.name: Holographic entropy inequalities
fine.description: Papers that characterise the holographic entropy cone and the entropy inequalities obeyed by holographic states.

fine.name: PEPS and 2D tensor networks
fine.description: Papers that optimise, evolve and contract projected entangled-pair states for two- and three-dimensional systems.

fine.name: Tree tensor networks and software
fine.description: Papers that develop tree tensor networks, time evolution schemes and software packages for tensor network simulation.

fine.name: Matrix product state theory
fine.description: Papers that study the structure, renormalisation and representational power of matrix product states and operators.

fine.name: Entanglement in non-Hermitian systems
fine.description: Papers that use entanglement entropy and its scaling to characterise criticality and transitions in non-Hermitian many-body systems.

fine.name: Quantum simulation of lattice gauge theories
fine.description: Papers that design algorithms and encodings to simulate Abelian and non-Abelian lattice gauge theories on quantum computers.

fine.name: String breaking and confinement dynamics
fine.description: Papers that simulate and observe string breaking, confinement and meson dynamics in lattice gauge theories on quantum hardware.

fine.name: Integrable spin chains
fine.description: Papers that build and solve integrable models with Bethe ansatz, Yang-Baxter equations and conserved charges.

fine.name: Geometric phases and quantum geometry
fine.description: Papers that study Berry phases, quantum geometric tensors and geometric formulations of quantum dynamics in closed and open systems.

fine.name: Many-body entanglement entropy
fine.description: Papers that compute entanglement entropy, negativity and symmetry-resolved entanglement in critical and quenched many-body systems.

fine.name: Anyonic and fractional statistics
fine.description: Papers that construct and realise anyons with fractional exchange statistics, especially in one-dimensional lattice models.

fine.name: Symmetry-protected and generalised symmetry phases
fine.description: Papers that classify SPT phases, anomalies and non-invertible or categorical symmetries in lattice models.

fine.name: Non-Abelian anyons and topological order
fine.description: Papers that create, braid and classify anyons and topological orders, including mixed-state order and string-net states.

fine.name: Twisted electrons and relativistic vortex states
fine.description: Papers that model vortex electron wave packets and twisted particles in strong fields, scattering and radiation.

fine.name: Optical vortex light-matter interaction
fine.description: Papers that study how optical vortex and vector beams transfer orbital angular momentum to atoms, ions and media.

fine.name: Electromagnetic vacuum fluctuations
fine.description: Papers that study vacuum field fluctuations, radiation reaction and motion-induced radiation near mirrors and moving bodies.

fine.name: Schwinger pair production
fine.description: Papers that compute electron-positron pair creation from vacuum in strong, pulsed and chirped electric fields.

fine.name: Casimir energy in field theory
fine.description: Papers that compute Casimir vacuum energy for scalar, Dirac and lattice fields under different boundary conditions.

fine.name: Casimir and Casimir-Polder forces
fine.description: Papers that measure and model Casimir and Casimir-Polder forces between real materials, including friction and nonequilibrium effects.

fine.name: Bound-state QED and exotic atoms
fine.description: Papers that calculate QED, relativistic and nuclear-size corrections in hydrogen-like ions, muonic atoms and positron binding.

fine.name: Aharonov-Bohm effect
fine.description: Papers that reinterpret, generalise and test the Aharonov-Bohm effect and the physical role of vector potentials.

fine.name: PT-symmetric quantum systems
fine.description: Papers that simulate and use PT- and anti-PT-symmetric Hamiltonians in qubits, photonics and state transfer.

fine.name: Pseudo-Hermitian quantum theory
fine.description: Papers that develop the mathematical framework of non-Hermitian and pseudo-Hermitian quantum mechanics, observables and metrics.

fine.name: Exceptional points
fine.description: Papers that create, classify and observe exceptional points and their dynamics in non-Hermitian and open quantum systems.

fine.name: Exceptional-point and non-Hermitian sensing
fine.description: Papers that test whether exceptional points and non-Hermitian dynamics really enhance sensor precision, using quantum Fisher information.

fine.name: Few-body physics and Efimov states
fine.description: Papers that solve two-, three- and four-body problems with contact interactions, including Efimov physics and scattering lengths.

fine.name: Formulations of quantum mechanics
fine.description: Papers that reformulate quantum mechanics and relate it to classical mechanics through trajectories, actions and hydrodynamics.

fine.name: Wigner function and phase-space methods
fine.description: Papers that develop Wigner functions and other phase-space representations for quantum dynamics.

fine.name: Relativistic wave equations
fine.description: Papers that study the Dirac and related relativistic equations, their interpretation, symmetries and field quantisation.

fine.name: Dunkl quantum mechanics
fine.description: Papers that solve oscillators and wave equations with Dunkl derivatives involving reflection operators.

fine.name: Generalised coherent states
fine.description: Papers that construct generalised coherent states and ladder operators for oscillators and other algebraic systems.

fine.name: Potential scattering theory
fine.description: Papers that develop transfer matrix and other methods for quantum and wave scattering from potentials.

fine.name: Bound states of model potentials
fine.description: Papers that solve Schrödinger, Klein-Gordon and Dirac equations for bound states of Coulomb-like and other model potentials.

fine.name: Exactly solvable potentials and oscillators
fine.description: Papers that find exact and approximate spectra of anharmonic oscillators and solvable potentials using supersymmetry, WKB and polynomials.

fine.name: Information thermodynamics and erasure
