fine.description: Papers that bound the thermodynamic cost of erasure and information processing, including Maxwell demons and second-law formulations.

fine.name: Entropy production and fluctuation theorems
fine.description: Papers that define and measure entropy production, fluctuation theorems and thermodynamic uncertainty relations in open quantum systems.

fine.name: Quantum work statistics
fine.description: Papers that define and measure quantum work distributions, Jarzynski equalities and quasiprobability approaches to work.

fine.name: Work extraction and ergotropy
fine.description: Papers that bound extractable work and ergotropy and the roles of coherence and correlations as thermodynamic resources.

fine.name: Quantum Mpemba effect
fine.description: Papers that predict and observe faster relaxation or symmetry restoration from initial states further from equilibrium.

fine.name: Quantum speed limits
fine.description: Papers that derive and test quantum speed limits on state, operator and open-system evolution.

fine.name: Quantum Zeno and anti-Zeno effects
fine.description: Papers that analyse Zeno and anti-Zeno effects from frequent measurement and use Zeno dynamics for control.

fine.name: Quantum thermometry
fine.description: Papers that design probes and protocols for estimating temperature with quantum Fisher information, often at low temperatures.

fine.name: Critical quantum metrology
fine.description: Papers that use quantum phase transitions and criticality to enhance parameter estimation precision.

fine.name: Lieb-Robinson bounds
fine.description: Papers that prove Lieb-Robinson bounds, light cones and propagation speed limits for many-body and open quantum systems.

fine.name: Leggett-Garg inequalities
fine.description: Papers that test macrorealism through Leggett-Garg inequality violations in qubits, fields and continuous-variable systems.

fine.name: Decoherence and entanglement dynamics
fine.description: Papers that track how coherence, entanglement and quantum correlations evolve when small systems couple to noisy environments.

fine.name: Gibbs sampling and thermal state preparation
fine.description: Papers that design quantum algorithms and Lindbladian dynamics to prepare thermal states and sample Gibbs distributions.

fine.name: Open quantum system master equations
fine.description: Papers that derive and solve Markovian and non-Markovian master equations and simulation methods for open quantum dynamics.

fine.name: Quantum tunnelling and tunnelling time
fine.description: Papers that model tunnelling through barriers and double wells and the time a particle spends tunnelling.

fine.name: Thermalisation and the ETH
fine.description: Papers that study how closed many-body systems thermalise, testing the eigenstate thermalisation hypothesis.

fine.name: Measurement-induced phase transitions
fine.description: Papers that study entanglement transitions in monitored circuits and continuously measured many-body systems.

fine.name: Quantum arrival times
fine.description: Papers that define and measure when a quantum particle arrives at a detector, including Bohmian and POVM approaches.

fine.name: Mathematical structure of quantum theory
fine.description: Papers that reconstruct or axiomatise quantum theory and examine Hilbert spaces, observables and operator algebras.

fine.name: History and ontology of quantum physics
fine.description: Papers that revisit the history of quantum theory and early debates about the reality of the wave function.

fine.name: Bohmian mechanics
fine.description: Papers that develop, test and debate Bohmian trajectories, pilot-wave models and their relativistic extensions.

fine.name: Quantum reference frames
fine.description: Papers that develop quantum reference frames, relational frame changes and the Page-Wootters approach to time.

fine.name: Born rule derivations
fine.description: Papers that derive, justify or test the Born rule for quantum probabilities.

fine.name: Quantum causal inference
fine.description: Papers that model causal structures with quantum latent variables and test nonclassicality in causal networks.

fine.name: Indefinite causal order
fine.description: Papers that study process matrices, the quantum switch and indefinite causal order in quantum processes.

fine.name: Interpreting Bell's theorem
fine.description: Papers that argue over what Bell's theorem and Bell experiments imply about locality, realism and hidden variables.

fine.name: Quantum contextuality
fine.description: Papers that develop Kochen-Specker and generalised contextuality, noncontextuality inequalities and contextuality as a resource.

fine.name: Interpretations and the measurement problem
fine.description: Papers that propose and compare interpretations of quantum mechanics and philosophical accounts of measurement and reality.

fine.name: QBism and observer-centred views
fine.description: Papers that discuss QBism, agents, experience and consciousness in the interpretation of quantum theory.

fine.name: Holographic and Krylov complexity
fine.description: Papers that relate computational and Krylov complexity to black hole interiors and holographic duals.

fine.name: Generalised uncertainty principle
fine.description: Papers that build minimal-length quantum mechanics from generalised uncertainty principles motivated by quantum gravity.

fine.name: Spontaneous collapse models
fine.description: Papers that develop and constrain spontaneous wave-function collapse models such as CSL with experiments.

fine.name: Gravity tests with clocks and collapse
fine.description: Papers that test gravitational time dilation, the equivalence principle and gravity-related collapse with quantum systems.

fine.name: Quantum clocks and time
fine.description: Papers that model quantum clocks, relational and emergent time, and quantum time dilation.

fine.name: Quantum cosmology and curved spacetime
fine.description: Papers that study quantum fields in curved spacetime, quantum cosmology and decoherence of inflationary perturbations.

fine.name: Entanglement near black holes
fine.description: Papers that compute how entanglement, steering and coherence degrade for observers near black holes and in non-inertial frames.

fine.name: Analogue Hawking radiation
fine.description: Papers that model and observe Hawking-like radiation in analogue horizons in fluids, condensates and optics.

fine.name: Black hole information problem
fine.description: Papers that study information loss, Page curves and the recovery of information from evaporating black holes.

fine.name: Gravitons and gravitational decoherence
fine.description: Papers that study graviton noise, quantum signatures of gravitational waves and gravity-induced decoherence.

fine.name: Gravitationally induced entanglement
fine.description: Papers that propose and analyse table-top tests of whether gravity can entangle masses and so must be quantum.

fine.name: Quantum correlations in neutrino oscillations
fine.description: Papers that apply coherence, entanglement and other quantum-information measures to neutrino flavour oscillations and their decoherence.

fine.name: Simulating collective neutrino oscillations
fine.description: Papers that model and quantum-simulate many-body collective neutrino flavour oscillations in dense astrophysical environments.

fine.name: Entanglement at colliders
fine.description: Papers that measure entanglement, Bell violation and quantum tomography in top-quark, Higgs and other collider events.

fine.name: Entanglement in scattering processes
fine.description: Papers that study entanglement generated in particle scattering, from Compton scattering to partons and nucleon interactions.

fine.name: Entanglement harvesting
fine.description: Papers that compute how Unruh-DeWitt detectors extract entanglement from quantum field vacua under different motions and spacetimes.

fine.name: Unruh effect and accelerated detectors
fine.description: Papers that study the Unruh effect and how acceleration affects correlations and coherence of Unruh-DeWitt detectors.
